d:
Greetings, young skyborne. I can see that you have much promise in the druidic arts. There is one who you may want to speak with in the city of Thunder Bluff by the name of Turak Runetotem. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, Moonglade.
You will be welcomed there, and the druids of the circle will impart their knowledge upon you.
As your people would say--go with the wind's blessing, young one. I wish you good fortune in your adventures.

Greetings, young adventurer.
Have you heard of the Cenarion Circle? I'd expect not. They are an ancient order of naturalists and practitioners of the druidic arts, much like yourself. In the city of Stormwind you'll find a night elf by the name of Sheldras Moontree. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, a place called Moonglade.
Go now. You have much to learn if you wish to save your home.
c:
Greetings, fellow adventurer. It pleases me to meet a fellow adventurer from among the Skyborne, and to be among the first to welcome you to Azeroth.
I think you will find that my fellow adventurers of the Cenarion Circle have much wisdom to impart upon you, child of nature.

d:
All adventurers are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade. Keeper Remulos--Moonglade's guardian--keeps watch over all adventurers who hibernate there. I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.
As for your first lesson here on Azeroth, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young adventurer.
c: Ah I see that you have already mastered the form of the Bear. Good, good. You are well on your way, young adventurer.

d:
I had intended to be the first of us to step foot onto Azeroth, but recent events with the cult have changed my plans. As a result, I will be remaining here in Valanaar for a time. Fret not though, we have several mages awaiting our people's arrival in Dalaran. I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we set our affairs in order here. We will call upon agents such as yourself when you are needed.
When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there.
c:
Ah, you've made it. Wonderful. It's going to take us some time to get ourselves established here, so you may want to take some time to explore the city. Be warned however, try not to venture too far from the safety of the city proper.
As idyllic as this new land appears, it can be extremely dangerous to wander outside of Dalaran without appropriate preparation and experience.

Well met, adventurer. I am Bolvar Fordragon, regent to the throne of Stormwind.
A Kirin Tor messenger told me to expect to receive members of the High Order, and here you stand. It's been some time since a high elf has stood in this throne room, but I am glad to accept you now as a guest.
On behalf of the King, I welcome you to Stormwind and give you leave to travel freely through alliance lands. Welcome to Azeroth, Skyborne.

d:
Every adventurer begins by learning the bond between beast and master. This is your first challenge. In time, you'll tame creatures from every corner of the world, but for now, start with our rivers and lakes on Zephras.
Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Windsong Crawler.
Show that you can earn its trust, and begin your path toward true mastery.
p: You will learn, friend, and one day you will be a great adventurer.
c: Well tamed, friend! You are becoming adept already.

d:
You've proven you can tame the river's crawler. Now it's time to test your skill on open ground. The plains of Zephras echo with the cries of the galestrider, a proud, winged adventurer that runs like the wind.
Take this Taming Rod and seek one out. Travel to the lowlands and earn its trust.
Show you're ready for the trials yet to come.
p: You will learn, friend, and one day you will be a great adventurer.
c: You're back already! Impressive speed, friend!
